passages.text: Sing to the LORD a new song; sing to the LORD, all the earth.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
He deserves worship.
Sing a new song to the LORD.
All the earth must sing to the LORD.
passages.original: שִׁ֣ירוּ לַ֭יהוָה שִׁ֣יר חָדָ֑שׁ שִׁ֥ירוּ לַ֝יהוָ֗ה כָּל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: Sing to the LORD, bless His name; proclaim His salvation day after day.
passages.sermon:
Sing to the LORD.
Bless His name.
Proclaim His salvation every day.
Tell people about His salvation each day.
passages.original: שִׁ֣ירוּ לַ֭יהוָה בָּרֲכ֣וּ שְׁמ֑וֹ בַּשְּׂר֥וּ מִיּֽוֹם־ לְ֝י֗וֹם יְשׁוּעָתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Declare His glory among the nations, His wonderful deeds among all peoples.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD.
\r\nGod is great.
\r\nGod is above all other gods.
\r\nGod made the heavens.
\r\nGod does wonderful deeds.
\r\nTell about God's glory to all nations.
\r\nTell about God's wonderful deeds to all peoples.
passages.original: סַפְּר֣וּ בַגּוֹיִ֣ם כְּבוֹד֑וֹ בְּכָל־ הָֽ֝עַמִּ֗ים נִפְלְאוֹתָֽיו׃

passages.text: For great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised; He is to be feared above all gods.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is great.
The LORD deserves much praise.
The LORD is above all gods.
People must fear the LORD more than any other god.
passages.original: כִּ֥י גָ֘ד֤וֹל יְהוָ֣ה וּמְהֻלָּ֣ל מְאֹ֑ד נוֹרָ֥א ה֝֗וּא עַל־ כָּל־ אֱלֹהִֽים׃

passages.text: For all the gods of the nations are idols, but it is the LORD who made the heavens.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
He made the heavens.
All the gods of the nations are idols.
Only the LORD created the heavens.
passages.original: כִּ֤י׀ כָּל־ אֱלֹהֵ֣י הָעַמִּ֣ים אֱלִילִ֑ים וַֽ֝יהוָ֗ה שָׁמַ֥יִם עָשָֽׂה׃

passages.text: Splendor and majesty are before Him; strength and beauty fill His sanctuary.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is great.
He stands above all gods.
Splendor stands before Him.
Majesty stands before Him.
Strength fills His sanctuary.
Beauty fills His sanctuary.
passages.original: הוֹד־ וְהָדָ֥ר לְפָנָ֑יו עֹ֥ז וְ֝תִפְאֶ֗רֶת בְּמִקְדָּשֽׁוֹ׃

passages.text: Ascribe to the LORD, O families of the nations, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the one true God.
He made the heavens.
All the gods of the nations are only idols.
Families of every nation, give honor to the LORD.
Give the LORD glory.
Give the LORD strength.
passages.original: הָב֣וּ לַ֭יהוָה מִשְׁפְּח֣וֹת עַמִּ֑ים הָב֥וּ לַ֝יהוָ֗ה כָּב֥וֹד וָעֹֽז׃

passages.text: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due His name; bring an offering and enter His courts.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
His name deserves glory.
Give the LORD the glory that belongs to Him.
Bring an offering to the LORD.
Enter the courts of the LORD.
passages.original: הָב֣וּ לַ֭יהוָה כְּב֣וֹד שְׁמ֑וֹ שְׂאֽוּ־ מִ֝נְחָ֗ה וּבֹ֥אוּ לְחַצְרוֹתָֽיו׃

passages.text: Worship the LORD in the splendor of His holiness; tremble before Him, all the earth.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is holy.
He is full of splendor.
Worship the LORD.
All the earth must tremble before Him.
passages.original: הִשְׁתַּחֲו֣וּ לַ֭יהוָה בְּהַדְרַת־ קֹ֑דֶשׁ חִ֥ילוּ מִ֝פָּנָ֗יו כָּל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: Declare among the nations: “The LORD reigns!” The world is firmly established; it cannot be moved; He will judge the peoples with equity.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is King.
Tell this to all nations.
The world stands firm.
Nothing can shake it.
The LORD will judge all people.
He will judge everyone with fairness.
passages.original: אִמְר֤וּ בַגּוֹיִ֨ם׀ יְה֘וָ֤ה מָלָ֗ךְ אַף־ תִּכּ֣וֹן תֵּ֭בֵל בַּל־ תִּמּ֑וֹט יָדִ֥ין עַ֝מִּ֗ים בְּמֵישָׁרִֽים׃

passages.text: Let the heavens be glad and the earth rejoice; let the sea resound, and all that fills it.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD.
God reigns over all creation.
The heavens are glad.
The earth rejoices.
The sea roars.
Everything in the sea joins in praise.
passages.original: יִשְׂמְח֣וּ הַ֭שָּׁמַיִם וְתָגֵ֣ל הָאָ֑רֶץ יִֽרְעַ֥ם הַ֝יָּ֗ם וּמְלֹאֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Let the fields exult, and all that is in them. Then all the trees of the forest will sing for joy before the LORD, for He is coming— He is coming to judge the earth. He will judge the world in righteousness and the peoples in His faithfulness.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is coming.
He is coming to judge the earth.
Let the fields be glad.
Let everything in the fields rejoice.
All the trees in the forest will sing for joy.
They will sing before the LORD.
He will judge the world with righteousness.
He will judge all people with faithfulness.
passages.original: יַעֲלֹ֣ז שָׂ֭דַי וְכָל־ אֲשֶׁר־ בּ֑וֹ אָ֥ז יְ֝רַנְּנ֗וּ כָּל־ עֲצֵי־ יָֽעַר׃ לִפְנֵ֤י יְהוָ֨ה׀ כִּ֬י בָ֗א כִּ֥י בָא֮ לִשְׁפֹּ֪ט הָ֫אָ֥רֶץ יִשְׁפֹּֽט־ תֵּבֵ֥ל בְּצֶ֑דֶק וְ֝עַמִּ֗ים בֶּאֱמוּנָתֽוֹ׃
